speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I understand you are experiencing weakness and fatigue; to help me identify the cause, please tell me how long these symptoms have been present and if they are worse in the morning or after exercise. Additionally, have you noticed any changes in your weight, appetite, or sleep patterns recently?

speaker: Patient
text: 33-year-old woman. The patient reports feeling extremely fatigued and weak, especially towards the end of the day, to the point of difficulty in self-care. She mentions experiencing these symptoms currently. The patient has been traveling, hiking, and camping recently and notes having had multiple illnesses in the recent past.

speaker: Doctor
text:
DIAGNOSIS READY: Myasthenia Gravis (suspected based on fatigability worsening later in the day and difficulty with self-care)

REQUEST TEST: Antibody testing for Anti-AChR and Anti-MuSK, Acetylcholine Receptor Antibody assay

REQUEST IMAGES: Electromyography (EMG) results for repetitive nerve stimulation
